name: RealWorldQA
intro: RealWorldQA是一个旨在评估多模态AI模型真实世界空间理解能力的基准测试。它通过700多张真实世界场景（包括车载图像）的图片，配以问题和可验证的答案，来评估模型对物理环境的理解能力。该基准测试要求模型能够识别高分辨率图像中的细节，并基于识别结果进行推理，可能需要常识性知识。
intro_en: RealWorldQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate the real-world spatial understanding capabilities of multimodal AI models. It uses over 700 images of real-world scenes, including in-car images, paired with questions and verifiable answers to assess models' understanding of physical environments. The benchmark requires models to identify details in high-resolution images and perform reasoning based on these observations, potentially involving commonsense knowledge.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with xAI official Hugging Face dataset card Introduction and release metadata; no accompanying paper or detailed annotation protocol is published. RealWorldQA has no accompanying benchmark paper. The xAI dataset card documents an initial release of 765 anonymized real-world images, including images taken from vehicles and other real-world scenes, with one question and an easily verifiable answer per image. It describes the goal as real-world understanding and releases the data under CC BY-ND 4.0, but does not disclose image sourcing proportions, question-authoring procedure, annotator counts, quality-control stages, prompt formatting, or an official answer parser. The diagram therefore shows only those confirmed stages and marks simple answer accuracy as the public evaluation convention rather than inventing a hidden construction pipeline.
